notes: The supplied text (catalog page 165) contains the tail of a Steamfitter program's outcomes and career information, then the 'A.A. in Welder Apprenticeship' section (Total Units: 56; 40 units from PLUMB 241/STMFT courses plus 16 units of work experience). It does not contain a section for the Certificate of Achievement 'Welder Apprenticeship Level II', so no requirements, total, outcomes or careers were recorded for this award. A reviewer should locate the certificate section, likely on the following page (166).
The A.A. section's Student Learning Outcomes and the description naming plumber, pipefitter, and steamfitter welders belong to the A.A. degree and were not recorded for this certificate.
In the A.A. section, STMFT 150-161 are titled Welding V through Welding X, which differs from the closed-list titles (Welding I-VI). The work experience courses there are listed at 0.5 - 6 units.
